description: Updates an existing action item: text, priority, due date, or assignee. Requires mcp:write scope.

action_item_id.description: The ID of the action item to update.

assign_to.description: User ID to reassign to — call retro.team.members.list to get it — or "me" to assign to the current user.

due.description: New due date in ISO 8601 format.

priority.description: New priority: high, medium, or low.

text.description: New text for the action item.

name: retro.actions.update
title: Update Action Item Tool
